services.value: Pace provides analytical and environmental testing services (including various listed analytes and test categories), plus professional services such as “Facilities Validation,” “Cleanroom Testing & Certification,” “Validation Services,” “Laboratory Relocation,” and “Environmental Monitoring.” The text also lists life sciences/CDMO services such as “Central Laboratory Services” and “Drug Product Development and Manufacturing” with “Analytical Testing” and “Regulatory and Operational Support.”
